items.title: The Folded Universe
items.question: Three pounds of wrinkled jelly run your whole life without moving an inch. What am I?
items.hintText:
Three pounds of wrinkled jelly.
I run everything without moving.
Skulls house my entire office.
items.correctExplanation: Brain — three pounds, wrinkled, motionless, running everything. Jelly commanding armies.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is brain. Weight plus wrinkles plus motionless-command isolates the organ: jelly that governs. Offices in skulls run bodies.
items.lessonContent:
Jelly governs armies daily here.
Wrinkles package vast networks.
Motionless command centers rule bodies.
Skulls house entire governments.
Share this: thank three pounds today.

items.title: The Weightless Arrow
items.question: I fly without wings and strike without wounding; once loosed, no shield recalls me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Wings never lift my flight.
Wounds never follow my strikes.
Loosed once, I never return.
items.correctExplanation: Thought — wingless flight, woundless strike, irreversible loosing. Arrows of mind.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is thought. Fly-without-wings plus strike-without-wounding plus never-recalled isolates thinking: launched ideas travel permanently. Shields fail against mind-arrows.
items.lessonContent:
Mind-arrows fly permanently onward.
Loosed ideas never return home.
Wounds absent, impacts present.
Shields fail against thinking.
Share this: loose one kind arrow.

items.title: The Unseen Theater
items.question: I stage impossible worlds nightly with no actors, no tickets, no audience awake. What am I?
items.hintText:
Nightly I stage impossibilities.
Actors never tread my boards.
Audiences sleep through my shows.
items.correctExplanation: Imagination — nightly impossible theater, actorless, ticketless, slept-through. Stages in darkness.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is imagination. Stage-impossible plus no-actors plus sleeping-audience isolates inner theater: dreams and daydreams share one stage. Darkness seats every show.
items.lessonContent:
Inner theaters run nightly always.
Actorless stages show impossibilities.
Sleeping audiences miss best shows.
Darkness seats wonder nightly.
Share this: attend one inner show.

items.title: The Why-to-Wow
items.question: I begin with why and end with wow; laboratories chase me daily. What am I?
items.hintText:
Whys begin all my journeys.
Wows conclude my arrivals.
Labs chase me daily.
items.correctExplanation: Discovery — why-beginning, wow-ending, lab-chased. Journeys from wonder to wonder.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is discovery. Begin-why plus end-wow plus labs-chase isolates finding: questions conceive what astonishment delivers. Whys birth wows reliably.
items.lessonContent:
Whys begin journeys ending in wows.
Labs chase what wonder starts.
Journeys outlast arrivals always.
Wows conclude well-begun whys.
Share this: why one wow today.

items.title: The Ending Starter
items.question: I end inquiries yet start arguments; essays bow out through me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Inquiries end where I stand.
Arguments ignite from my ashes.
Essays bow out through my door.
items.correctExplanation: Conclusion — ending inquiries, starting arguments, bowing essays out. Doors that open debates.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is conclusion. End-inquiries plus start-arguments isolates closers: ashes igniting fresh fires. Bowings-out begin shoutings.
items.lessonContent:
Inquiries end where I stand nightly.
Ashes ignite fresh arguments.
Essays exit through closing doors.
Endings start discussions reliably.
Share this: conclude one inquiry well.

items.title: The Cold Compass
items.question: I navigate storms of feeling without ever feeling; captains who ignore me wreck on passion's rocks. What am I?
items.hintText:
Storms need my navigation most.
Feelings never touch my needle.
Ignored, I wreck ships surely.
items.correctExplanation: Reason — feelingless navigator through passion's storms. Cold compasses steer warm ships.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is reason. Navigate-without-feeling plus wreck-if-ignored isolates rationality: compasses care nothing for seas they cross. Captains need cold needles.
items.lessonContent:
Compasses care nothing for seas.
Cold needles steer warm ships.
Feelingless navigation saves passion-tossed.
Ignored compasses wreck surely.
Share this: consult one cold needle.

items.title: The Testable Ghost
items.question: I haunt laboratories as a guess wearing a lab coat; experiments are my exorcisms. What am I?
items.hintText:
Labs host my ghostly guesses.
Coats of method dress my haunting.
Experiments exorcise me properly.
items.correctExplanation: Hypothesis — lab-coated guess awaiting exorcism by experiment. Ghosts that beg testing.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is hypothesis. Haunt-labs plus wear-coats plus exorcise-by-experiment isolates testable ghosts: guesses seeking disproof. Exorcisms advance science.
items.lessonContent:
Guesses seek disproof honorably.
Coats of method dress hauntings.
Exorcisms advance all science.
Ghosts begging tests progress fastest.
Share this: exorcise one guess.

items.title: The Loving Wisdom
items.question: I begin in wonder and end without ending; Socrates claimed me as his only business. What am I?
items.hintText:
Wonder births all my inquiries.
Endings never close my books.
Socrates made me his business.
items.correctExplanation: Philosophy — wonder-born, endless, Socratic business. Loving wisdom without final embrace.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is philosophy. Begin-wonder plus end-without-ending plus Socrates-business isolates wisdom-love: questions outliving answers eternally. Businesses dealing in wonder.
items.lessonContent:
Wonder births endless inquiries.
Businesses dealing in questions thrive.
Endings never close these books.
Loving wisdom outlives answers.
Share this: wonder philosophically once.

items.title: The Prepared Dawn
items.question: Long confusion prepares my single bright second; readiness meets moment in me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Confusion prepares my arrival.
Single seconds deliver my light.
Readiness meets moments through me.
items.correctExplanation: Realization — confusion-prepared, second-delivered, readiness-meeting. Dawns after long nights.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is realization. Prepare-long plus deliver-instant isolates dawning: muddles resolving into brightness. Nights labor; seconds deliver.
items.lessonContent:
Confusion prepares bright seconds.
Seconds deliver years of fog-lifting.
Readiness meets moments precisely.
Bright arrivals end long muddles.
Share this: realize one prepared thing.

items.title: The Faster Mind
items.question: I act before thought finishes deliberating; animals trust me completely with their lives. What am I?
items.hintText:
Deliberation lags behind my leaps.
Animals trust me with lives.
Thought finishes after I act.
items.correctExplanation: Instinct — acting pre-thought, trusted by animals, outrunning deliberation. Wordless wisdom in motion.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is instinct. Act-before-thought plus animal-trusted isolates inborn knowing: leaps preceding reasons. Deliberation trails acting reliably.
items.lessonContent:
Leaps precede deliberations daily.
Animals trust wordless urges fully.
Thought trails acting reliably.
Wordless wisdom moves first.
Share this: trust one leap kindly.

items.title: The Struck Bell
items.question: I ring once and understanding resonates for years; teachers live to strike me in students. What am I?
items.hintText:
Single rings resonate for years.
Teachers live to strike me.
Understanding echoes my tone.
items.correctExplanation: Epiphany — single ring, years of resonance, teachers' holy grail. Bells that re-tune minds.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is epiphany. Ring-once plus resonate-years plus teachers-strike isolates revelation: tones re-tuning listeners permanently. Holy grails ring in classrooms.
items.lessonContent:
Single rings resonate for years.
Tones re-tune listeners permanently.
Teachers strike for holy grails.
Revelation outlasts instruction vastly.
Share this: ring one bell today.

items.title: The Eaten Past
items.question: I devour whole years yet leave their lessons; trauma feeds me while therapy starves me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Years vanish down my gullet.
Lessons survive my digestion.
Therapy starves what trauma feeds.
items.correctExplanation: Amnesia — devouring years, sparing lessons, fed by trauma. Gullets swallowing calendars.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is amnesia. Devour-years plus spare-lessons plus trauma-fed isolates forgetting: calendars eaten, skills excreted intact. Gullets swallow time itself.
items.lessonContent:
Calendars eaten, skills excreted intact.
Gullets swallow time itself nightly.
Trauma feeds what therapy starves.
Forgetting spares lessons strangely.
Share this: digest one year kindly.

items.title: The Bittersweet Home
items.question: I ache for places that never existed as remembered; immigrants carry me like luggage. What am I?
items.hintText:
Nonexistent pasts ache through me.
Immigrants pack me as luggage.
Memory edits what I mourn.
items.correctExplanation: Nostalgia — aching for edited pasts, luggage of the displaced. Homes remembered never existed.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is nostalgia. Ache-for-unreal plus immigrant-luggage isolates homesickness for fiction: edited memories mourned truly. Luggage overweight with unreality.
items.lessonContent:
Edited pasts ache truly daily.
Luggage overweights with unreality.
Homes remembered never existed.
Mourning fictions comforts exiles.
Share this: unpack one luggage.

items.title: The Night Terror
items.question: I chase sleepers who cannot wake though dreaming; mornings dissolve what midnight made real. What am I?
items.hintText:
Sleepers flee without moving.
Mornings dissolve midnight realities.
Dreaming makes me terrifyingly real.
items.correctExplanation: Nightmare — chasing non-waking sleepers, dissolved by mornings. Terror with no exit but dawn.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is nightmare. Chase-without-waking plus dissolve-by-morning isolates bad dreams: paralyzed flight, vivid threat. Dawns acquit all dreamers.
items.lessonContent:
Sleeping flight goes nowhere fast.
Mornings dissolve midnight realities.
Dreaming makes terrors feel real.
Fleeing still while panicking defines it.
Share this: outrun one night terror.

items.title: The Waking Dream
items.question: Eyes open, I screen private movies no one else can see; teachers confiscate my attention daily. What am I?
items.hintText:
Open eyes screen my movies.
No one else buys tickets.
Teachers confiscate me daily.
items.correctExplanation: Daydream — open-eyed private cinema, unticketed, confiscated by teachers. Daylight movies for one.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is daydream. Eyes-open plus private-movies plus teacher-confiscated isolates waking fantasy: attention screening inward. Classrooms compete with inner cinemas.
items.lessonContent:
Open-eyed movies play privately.
Tickets never sold for these shows.
Confiscated attentions screen best.
Private cinemas run daylight hours.
Share this: screen one private movie.

items.title: The Unshared Vision
items.question: I show what isn't there to one viewer alone; fevers and grief project me vividly. What am I?
items.hintText:
Solo audiences watch my shows.
Fevers project me vividly.
Grief screens my features.
items.correctExplanation: Hallucination — solo-audience visions, fever-projected, grief-screened. Shows for one.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is hallucination. One-viewer plus fever/grief-projected isolates unreal seeing: private screenings with no film. Solo shows convince singly.
items.lessonContent:
Solo audiences prove nothing shared.
Fevers project vivid unreality.
Grief screens private features.
Unshared visions convince singly.
Share this: doubt one solo show.

items.title: The Honest Trick
items.question: Magicians and deserts both deal in me; eyes report what physics denies. What am I?
items.hintText:
Magicians deal me nightly.
Deserts stock my mirages.
Eyes report denied physics.
items.correctExplanation: Illusion — magician-dealt, desert-stocked, physics-denying. Honest trickery of eyes.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is illusion. Magicians-plus-deserts plus eyes-report-denied isolates seeming: organs fooled, minds informed. Tricks honest about deceiving.
items.lessonContent:
Eyes report denied physics daily.
Mirages stock deserts and stages.
Denied realities persuade eyes.
Honest tricks fool organs, not minds.
Share this: see through one trick.

items.title: The Silent Premise
items.question: I underlie every argument unspoken; expose me and debates collapse or clarify. What am I?
items.hintText:
Arguments stand upon me silently.
Exposure collapses or clarifies all.
Debates orbit my hidden mass.
items.correctExplanation: Assumption — silent underlier of arguments, collapsing or clarifying when exposed. Gravity of debates.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is assumption. Underlie-unspoken plus expose-collapses isolates premises: hidden masses bending debates. Orbits reveal centers.
items.lessonContent:
Silent standings support loud debates.
Exposure clarifies or collapses fast.
Hidden masses bend arguments.
Unspoken grounds decide outcomes.
Share this: expose one silent ground.

items.title: The Borrowed Map
items.question: I explain the strange by the familiar, mapping kingdoms onto cells. What am I?
items.hintText:
Strange lands map through familiar ones.
Kingdoms explain cells nightly.
Borrowed maps guide new territories.
items.correctExplanation: Analogy — strange-by-familiar mapping, kingdom-to-cell bridging. Borrowed understanding.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is analogy. Explain-strange plus map-familiar isolates comparison: borrowed maps for new territories. Kingdoms illuminate cells.
items.lessonContent:
Borrowed maps guide new territories.
Familiar lands explain strange ones.
Mappings transfer understanding fast.
Kingdoms illuminate cells nightly.
Share this: map one strange land.

items.title: The Carrying Across
items.question: My Greek name means carrying across; I say the moon is a coin and mean it truly. What am I?
items.hintText:
Greeks named my carrying-across.
Moons become coins through me.
Truly meant, literally false.
items.correctExplanation: Metaphor — Greek carrying-across, moon-coin minting, truly-meant falsity. Transfers that transform.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is metaphor. Name-means-carrying plus moon-coin plus truly-false isolates figurative transfer: bridges between unlike shores. Etymology confesses method.
items.lessonContent:
Carrying-across transfers meaning daily.
Moons mint into coins nightly.
Literally false, truly meant always.
Transfers bridge unlike shores.
Share this: mint one moon-coin.

items.title: The Opposite Meaning
items.question: I praise to blame and blame to praise; the literal-minded miss me entirely. What am I?
items.hintText:
Praise delivers blame through me.
Literal minds miss me completely.
Opposites trade places nightly.
items.correctExplanation: Irony — praising to blame, missed by literals. Opposites trading places.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is irony. Praise-blame plus blame-praise plus literal-missed isolates inversion: meanings wearing opposite masks. Masks slip for the knowing.
items.lessonContent:
Opposites trade places nightly.
Praise wounds; blame caresses here.
Literal minds miss everything.
Meanings invert deliciously.
Share this: praise one blame tonight.

items.title: The Laugh Detonator
items.question: Stories march toward me and explode in laughter; timing is my fuse. What am I?
items.hintText:
Stories march toward my blast.
Timing fuses all my powder.
Laughter explodes on my arrival.
items.correctExplanation: Punchline — marched-toward, fuse-timed, laughter-detonating. Endings that explode.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is punchline. March-toward plus timing-fuse plus laughter-blast isolates closers: setups detonate on schedule. Fuses measure funniness.
items.lessonContent:
Stories march toward explosions.
Timing fuses comic powder.
Laughter detonates on arrival.
Marches end in blasts nightly.
Share this: time one blast well.

items.title: The Told Thing
items.question: I have beginnings, middles, and ends, yet I never happened; children demand me nightly. What am I?
items.hintText:
Beginnings, middles, ends structure me.
Happening never troubles my truth.
Children demand me every night.
items.correctExplanation: Story — structured unhappening, nightly demanded. Beginnings without events.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is story. Structure-without-happening plus nightly-demanded isolates tales: shape without fact. Children commission fictions.
items.lessonContent:
Beginnings structure unhappened truths.
Demanded nightly by small listeners.
Truth untroubled by happening.
Told things outlast lived ones.
Share this: tell one untold tonight.

items.title: The Shared Code
items.question: Infants crack me without lessons; poets stretch me till I sing. What am I?
items.hintText:
Infants crack me lesson-free.
Poets stretch me into song.
Codes shared build whole worlds.
items.correctExplanation: Language — lesson-free cracking, stretch-into-song. Codes building worlds.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is language. Infant-cracked plus poet-stretched isolates shared code: grammar without school, music without notes. Worlds built from babble.
items.lessonContent:
Codes shared build whole worlds.
Lesson-free infants crack vast systems.
Stretching sings what rules recite.
Shared systems carry civilizations.
Share this: stretch one code singing.

items.title: The Distilled Cry
items.question: I compress oceans into thimbles; readers sip me slowly for years. What am I?
items.hintText:
Oceans compress into my thimbles.
Readers sip me across decades.
Thimbles hold what seas cannot.
items.correctExplanation: Poem — ocean-compressing, decade-sipped. Thimbles outholding seas.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is poem. Compress-oceans plus sip-decades isolates verse: vastness thimbled. Readers drink slowly what poets distilled fast.
items.lessonContent:
Oceans compress into thimbles daily.
Sipping lasts decades per thimble.
Compression distills vast seas.
Thimbles outhold oceans strangely.
Share this: sip one thimble slowly.
